Once upon a time, a small fox lived beside a quiet hill.
Every morning, the fox watched birds fly over the green trees.
One rainy day, the fox found a warm red scarf near the river.
The fox carried it home and shared it with a cold little rabbit.
They became good friends and explored the hill together.
At sunset, they returned home, happy and safe.
